scope: Linux headless affected regression; not native GPU, human controller, story closure or chapter package acceptance.
difference_note: Original runners only retain per-suite timing and total checks. Exact attribution of the 20-check difference remains unestablished; no platform cause is claimed and tests were not weakened or rerun to normalize counts.
child_exit_note: Unmodified runner does not retain individual child exit codes. Raw result lines and actual overall exit are preserved.
raw_diagnostics: Fault-injection and exit diagnostics remain in unfiltered raw logs; success means zero new/known failures and no Script/Parse/Compile Error, not absence of every ERROR word.
